text: Experiment 69 closed Gromark in base 10 with a free alphabet. This runs the same exact test in every other base up to 16, and in base 26.
In base 2 with primer 10110, places 26 and 27 both carve Q but land in slots 13 and 15: dead whatever the alphabet.
15,135,782 primers across 146 base-and-rule settings, four forms: none consistent on K4 or on any shuffled copper. Two-term Gromark is exhausted.
